title: Nhận định Pháp vs Senegal — World Cup 2026

scenes.subjectHint: Hook split-frame — Mbappe (Pháp) vs Mane (Senegal), cúp World Cup ở giữa
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 split-frame football poster artwork showing a 2026 FIFA World Cup group-stage showdown. Left half: Kylian Mbappe, the French forward and captain for the France national team, in a deep blue France home kit with the white-and-red collar and the French Football Federation cockerel crest clearly visible on the chest, intense focused hero pose with arms slightly spread. Behind him, a stylized royal-blue France graphic backdrop with a huge faint cockerel crest watermark and radiating light rays. Right half: Sadio Mane, the Senegalese forward for the Senegal national team, in a white Senegal home kit with green-and-gold trim and the Lion of Teranga crest clearly visible on the chest, mirroring determined hero pose. Behind him, a stylized white-and-green Senegal graphic backdrop with a huge faint lion crest watermark and radiating light rays. Down the centre seam: a diagonal lightning-burst slash separator with dramatic energy glow, the golden FIFA World Cup trophy glowing as a stylized graphic accent between them. Vibrant saturated palette per side, very high contrast, glossy graphic-design finish. Stylized like a World Cup matchday rivalry promotional poster. Both crests visible on the jerseys, no on-image text or captions, no scoreboard graphics.
